verdict.summary_en: Karton Nowak order confirmation OA26324887 for Soony Interactive GmbH's order 4500318740 of 2026-09-18. It confirms one line: 65,000 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PEGI), CMP-GAM-004, at 0.06 EUR each, for 2026-10-16. Terms are DAP Hamburg and NET30. The supplier says it printed to artwork rev. C, received from Soony Marketing on 2026-08-07.
red_flags: The supplier states it printed to artwork rev. C. The document does not say whether rev. C is the current approved revision, so the buyer should check this against the artwork revision it holds.
The document carries no issue date of its own.
observations: Single-page, typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no date of issue; the only dates are the order date, the confirmed delivery date and the artwork receipt date.
The line total is not stated.
